assumptions: Official Topps Hobby odds are used without inventing missing odds.
Within each mapped checklist pool, eligible physical checklist cards are treated as equally likely unless card-level weighting is published.
The checklist label 'Chrome Autographs' is explicitly normalized to the Topps odds-map label 'Chrome Autograph Cards'.
For pooled common inserts, the five 20-card themes are treated as the published shared 100-card odds pool.
A multi-subject checklist card counts as one physical card for each named player's personal hit probability.
Unresolved team assignments are not inferred.
Category hit chances use an independence approximation across published odds rows; documented collation constraints can refine this later.
The overall player hit chance combines base-parallel, insert and autograph category hit chances with an independence approximation.
